crossRefs.note: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and…
He came even before the king’s gate, for no one is allowed inside the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.
and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to Pharaoh’s staff, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
translations.bsb: When the days of mourning had passed, Joseph said to Pharaoh’s court, “If I have found favor in your eyes, please tell Pharaoh that
translations.kjv: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
